no-restricted-syntax.message: Use <Input />, <Checkbox />, <Radio /> or <Toggle /> from '@tarodan/ui' instead of raw <input>. For file uploads, <input type='file' /> is still allowed.
Use <Button /> or <IconButton /> from '@tarodan/ui' instead of raw <button>.
Use semantic color tokens (primary, danger, success, info, warning, surface, heading, body, muted, subtle, border) instead of raw Tailwind palette colors.
Use semantic color tokens (surface-elevated, heading, inverted, border, etc.) instead of raw white/black utilities.

Remove redundant default classes on <Input>/<Textarea>/<Select>. Classes like w-full, border, border-gray-300, rounded-lg, px-3, py-2, focus:outline-none, focus:ring-2, focus:ring-primary-500 are already applied by the component. Only pass project-specific overrides.
Redundant: <Input>/<Textarea>/<Select> already apply focus:ring-primary-200 by default. Drop this class.

Use <Button variant="primary|secondary|danger"> from '@tarodan/ui' instead of the .btn-* helper classes. The btn-* CSS helpers have been removed; they re-applied the component defaults and created variant/style mismatches.

Never hand-write a queryKey array. Use the central registry (web: queryKeys/webKeys in '@/lib/query/keys'; admin: adminKeys) so a query and its invalidation cannot drift, and SSR seeds match. A bare [variable] key is allowed.
